summary: Every Hugging Face user receives monthly credits for Inference Providers. Free users get $0.10 per month (subject to change) for Inference Providers only; extra usage requires purchasing credits. PRO users get $2.00 per month in general-purpose compute credits (Inference Providers, Endpoints, Spaces hardware, Jobs). Credits apply when requests are routed by Hugging Face, not when using a custom provider key. This reactivates the previously archived hugging-face-inference-credits listing.
claim_steps: Create a Hugging Face account (no card required for the free tier).
Call Inference Providers routed by Hugging Face so monthly credits apply.
After credits are exhausted, purchase additional credits for pay-as-you-go.

social_proof.text: Free Users $0.10, subject to change, Inference Providers. PRO Users $2.00 All Hugging Face compute services. Credits included with PRO/Team/Enterprise are general-purpose compute credits.
